description.value: This study investigated gray matter volume differences between alcohol dependent patients and healthy controls, associations between orbitofrontal gray matter volume and negative affect during withdrawal, and prediction of heavy relapse risk at 6 months.

spans.text: Findings revealed GM volume decrease in alcoholics in the prefrontal cortex (including medial OFC), anterior cingulate gyrus, and insula. GM volume in the medial OFC was positively associated with NA in the ADP group. Cox regression analysis predicted that risk to heavy relapse at 6 months increases with decreased GM volume in the medial OFC.

description.value: VBM8 preprocessing with segmentation, spatial normalization, modulation and smoothing of T1-weighted images.

spans.text: The pre-processing pipeline of the T1 -weightened images included manual reorientation of the T1 -weighted images to set origins to be the anterior-posterior commissure (AC-PC) line, segmentation to classify different tissue types in each subject/image, spatial normalization to Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI) standard space, modulation of normalized segments, smoothing using an 8-mm full width at half maximum (FWHM) isotropic Gaussian filter .

We implemented the VBM8 toolbox default segmentation incorporating Diffeomorphic Anatomical Registration through Exponentiated Lie Algebra (DARTEL) template provided with the toolbox ( http://www.dbm.neuro.uni-jena.de/spm ) in Statistical Parametric Mapping software (SPM8, Wellcome Department of Imaging Neurosciences, University College London, UK)
